outcome: Payment reminder: Finance prepares, schedules, sends or sets aside the reminder for one invoice, live
acceptance_criteria: From Payments, a row with `reminder_url` links to `/finance/payments/{case_id}/invoices/{issue_id}/reminder`; a row with `reminder_url: null` or `issue_id: null` shows no link — verify: unit test on `PaymentsView`/`model.ts`; e2e click-through at 4990.
The page shows the live reference, `owed` with `currency`, `due_date`, recipient name and email, subject and message — verify: e2e on fixture 1; a `owed` of null shows "Unknown", never 0.

The page draws no "Overdue by", no "Last payment", no "7 days" text and no "Copy:" line — verify: e2e text absence on fixtures 1 and 5; grep `frontend/src/features/finance/reminder` for `days overdue` and `7 days` returns nothing.

Saving the draft posts `{revision, subject, message, attachment_id, attachment_checked}` with the read's `revision`, then re-reads — verify: unit/e2e request assertion on the mock; a 409 shows the server message and keeps the typed text; a 422 field error shows under its field.
Send posts `{action:"send", draft_id, revision}` once per press; a second press while pending sends nothing — verify: e2e counts one request on a double click.
Schedule posts `scheduled_for` as an ISO date-time and appears only when `can_schedule` is true — verify: e2e with fixture 1 and a fixture with `can_schedule:false`.
Not now requires a reason (1..1000 chars); an empty reason blocks the request; success shows "Set aside, nothing was sent" — verify: e2e.
Cancel schedule is offered only for a scheduled dispatch with no receipt and posts `{action:"cancel_schedule", dispatch_id, revision}` — verify: e2e on fixture 3.

Check mailbox is offered only for a `synthetic_mailbox` dispatch with no receipt and posts `{action:"check_mailbox", dispatch_id}`; Record delivery posts `confirm` with `evidence_id` chosen from `receipt_proofs`, `delivered`, `reference` and is offered only when `can_confirm` is true — verify: e2e on fixture 4 and a fixture with `can_confirm:false`.

After a failed or timed-out send (mock returns 503 once, then the read shows the dispatch), the page does not offer a new Send for that draft and shows "Delivery not confirmed yet" with Check mailbox or Record delivery — verify: e2e.
`hold` text is shown verbatim and Send, Schedule, Edit are disabled while it is set; `recipient: null` also disables Send — verify: e2e on fixture 2.

`timing` values drive the follow-up lines; `earliest_date: null` hides that line; `awaiting_receipt: true` shows "Waiting for the original receipt"; `timing: null` shows no follow-up line — verify: unit test on `model.ts`.
`mode` and the scheduled send time show in the dispatch block — verify: e2e on fixture 3.
Negative: 403, 404 and 5xx each show their own state with the server message; a malformed `issueId` or `caseId` shows not-found with no API call — verify: e2e, request log.

Negative: a user without access to the case sees no draft text and no action buttons; the mock returns 403 for the wrong user and the page keeps no earlier data on screen — verify: e2e persona switch.

No request goes to `POST /setup/{case_id}/payment-reminder-rules` and `src/features/workspace` has no changed file — verify: `git diff --stat origin/main -- frontend/src/features/workspace` is empty (or only F-85 files already on main); request log.
Phone width (390) shows the same facts and actions in one column with no horizontal scroll — verify: e2e at 390.

Against Django at 8030 with the live adapter, the read of one seeded invoice renders and the save and send actions return 201 and 200 — verify: manual run recorded in the build notes; the mock is the CI evidence.

Unit tests cover `model.ts` mapping (state selection, hold, timing, unknown money) and the action body builders, including that a missing `revision` disables actions — verify: `vitest` on `frontend/src/features/finance/reminder`.

risk.rationale: High. The feature sends a client-facing message about money owed, so a wrong amount, recipient or duplicate send is hard to undo. It also covers scheduling, an uncertain-delivery reconcile path (`confirm`) and a contract move from work-scoped to invoice-scoped. Every send must go through the live action with the draft `revision`. A retry after an uncertain dispatch must go through `confirm` or `check_mailbox`, never a blind resend.
